notes.title: V1.6
notes.content:
Weapon Changes:
- Katana: Hold Trigger to charge when drawing the sword; after fully charged, drawing the sword can parry enemies.
- Demon Blade: Attacks include additional purple blade damage.
- Shadowless Sword: Weapon attack range increases with level.
New Systems:
- Gem System: Awaken combat styles through gem attributes.
- New Scrolls: Use gold to purchase Sword Souls to upgrade weapons.
Combat Tweaks:
- Parrying with the sheath no longer interrupts attacks from large enemies.
Bug Fixes:
- Bug where combat style would become inactive after finishing with Shadow or Demon Blade.
- Bug where returning to the lobby from the tutorial could result in a black screen.
- Bug where Lightning Chain of Thunder Sword would not display.

notes.title: V1.30
notes.content:
**Version 1.30:**  
🆕 **New Content:**  
- **Yi's Assistance:** Unlockable at the scroll; trigger by right controller B button.  
- **Yi's English Voice Acting:** Automatically enabled (Chinese and Japanese regions will continue using the original Chinese voice).  
- **BGM Volume Adjustment:** Now available in the settings.  

🔧 **Optimizations:**  
- **Loading Screen Overhaul:** Improved loading screen visuals.  
- **Enemy Death Interaction:** You can now stab enemies' bodies with the sword after they die.  
- **Enhanced Enemy Ragdoll Physics:** Improved physical reactions of enemy ragdolls.  
- **Improved Barrel Collisions:** Barrels now have more accurate collision detection — you can stuff enemies inside them.  
- **Lower Enemy Health:** Some enemies’ health has been reduced for better balance.  

🐛 **Bug Fixes:**  
- **Lightning Not Appearing:** Fixed an issue where lightning would not appear when using Thunderstorm for the first time.  
- **Missing Characters in English:** Fixed some fonts displaying as empty squares in the English version.  
- **Missing Text in Sword Rain Tutorial:** Fixed missing tutorial text for Sword Rain in the advanced tutorial in the English version.

notes.title: SwordTrip: Endless Realm
notes.content:
**Version 1.26:**  

- **New Features:**  
  - Endless Mode: Experience sword collisions and challenge the ultimate leaderboard!  
  - Multiple sword tassel entries: Each tassel entry introduces unique gameplay mechanics.  
  - Adjustable special effect volume.  

- **Optimizations:**  
  - Improved initial velocity with physical effects when enemies die, enhancing kill feedback.  
  - Added subtitle prompts for how to start the game. The advanced tutorial is now locked until Easy difficulty is cleared.  

- **Bug Fixes:**  
  - Fixed a critical bug where oversized paper could corrupt save files.  
  - Fixed a subtitle bug related to acquiring sword spirits.
